bio.text: Dan Saddler represents Chugiak-Eagle River and Peters Creek in the Alaska House of Representatives (District 24), where he served from 2011 to 2018 and has served again since 2023.
His legislative biography says he was House Majority Leader in 2023 to 2024.
It says he had a 10-year career as a journalist and nearly 20 years in Alaska's legislative and executive branches before his first election.
